Average marginal effects and contrasts

Source: R/effects.R
avg_effects.Rd

For a numeric covariate, the average over the rows of the derivative of the predicted quantity with respect to the covariate (the average marginal effect, or average slope); for a factor, logical or character covariate, the average over the rows of the difference between the predictions with every row set to each level and with every row set to the reference level (g-computation; the average treatment effect under the usual assumptions). These are the avg_slopes() and avg_comparisons() of marginaleffects and the average marginal effects of Stata's margins, dydx().

Usage

avg_effects(
  object,
  variables = NULL,
  type = c("mean", "parameter", "link"),
  par = NULL,
  newdata = NULL,
  re = c("conditional", "zero"),
  level = 0.95,
  vcov = "model",
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A fitted model.

variables

Covariates; by default every covariate of the model.

type

"mean" (the predicted mean), "parameter" (a distribution parameter) or "link" (its linear predictor).

par

Distribution parameter for type = "parameter" or "link".

newdata

Rows to average over; the analysis rows by default.

re

"conditional" (with the estimated random effects) or "zero" (random effects set to zero).

level

Interval level.

vcov, ...

Covariance choice for frequentist fits (see vcov.regcomp_fit()).

Value

A data frame with one row per covariate (or contrast).

Details

Frequentist fits use the delta method with the chosen covariance (random effects are held at their estimates); Bayesian fits summarize the effect over the posterior draws.

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(300), g = factor(sample(c("a", "b", "c"), 300, TRUE)))
d$y <- rbinom(300, 1, plogis(-0.5 + 0.8 * d$x + (d$g == "b")))
f <- regcomp(y ~ x + g, family = "bernoulli", data = d)
avg_effects(f)
#>   term contrast   estimate  std_error statistic      p_value      lower
#> 1    x    dY/dX  0.1572576 0.02594746  6.060616 1.356008e-09  0.1064015
#> 2    g    b - a  0.2472136 0.06423042  3.848856 1.186709e-04  0.1213243
#> 3    g    c - a -0.1056021 0.06346644 -1.663904 9.613154e-02 -0.2299940
#>        upper
#> 1 0.20811367
#> 2 0.37310294
#> 3 0.01878985
